title: Exact localized source row and comparison squares for a K-flat cone
statement: Use the rings R,A,B,C, scalar-extension F, K-flat Q, coefficient complex N and chain map t:F(Q)→N of the parent diagram. Assume C is flat over E=A tensor_R B. Let f:P1→P2 be an actual chain map of K-flat A-complexes and P3=mappingCone(f), with arbitrary base-derived tensor cohomology models m1,m2,m3 of P1 tensor Q, P2 tensor Q and P3 tensor Q [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model]. Put c(P,m,j)=m.localizedComparison(j) followed by H^j(μ_F(P,Q)^(-1);F(P) tensor t). For every i there exist four maps s0,s1,s2,s3 between the localized model cohomologies of P1,P2,P3 at i and P1,P2 at i+1, forming an exact five-term source row. Set d0=H^i(F(f) tensor N), d1=H^i(F(inr f) tensor N), d3=H^(i+1)(F(f) tensor N), and fix d2 to homologyδOfTriangle(tensorConeTriangle(F,f,N),i,i+1) [lem-pc-tensor-cone-five-term-exact]. The four squares s0;c(P2,i)=c(P1,i);d0, s1;c(P3,i)=c(P2,i);d1, s2;c(P1,i+1)=c(P3,i);d2, s3;c(P2,i+1)=c(P1,i+1);d3 commute. This statement does not assert target exactness (proved separately), choose unrelated target rows, or require invertible comparisons.

source.place: Exact derived tensor and its universal counit, with Tag 0BYJ and Tag 0DJA(1); parent diagram steps 2 and 4. The cone summand compatibility is the explicit agent expansion of those steps.

proof.text: Let H be the total tensor functor with fixed second factor Q and T its image of the actual cone triangle. The upstream map₂CochainComplexFlipObjMapMappingConeTriangleIso identifies T with the cone triangle of f tensor Q, so localization of T is distinguished. Apply exists_baseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel_triangle_rows to T and the prescribed three models. This supplies the exact localized source row and four squares into F(T) homology.

For every chain map g and degree j, prove H(F(g tensor Q));H(a(V))=H(a(U));H(F(g) tensor N), where a(V) is the inverse tensorator followed by F(V) tensor t. Combine homologyMap_comp, oplax tensorator naturality and whisker_exchange. Apply this to f in degrees i and i+1, and to the cone inclusion in degree i; compose with the corresponding model squares.

Apply tensorCoefficient_cone_boundary to the actual cone of f. Compose its boundary square with the universal-model boundary square, using associativity. Together with the three ordinary squares and unchanged exact source row this is precisely the desired existential conclusion. No K-flatness is needed for these chain-level operations, but all original hypotheses remain in the statement.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_localizedTensorComparison_cone_rows
    (hC : Module.Flat (A ⊗[R] B) C)
    (P₁ P₂ : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (f : P₁ ⟶ P₂)
    (m₁ : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B (P₁ ⊗ Q) C)
    (m₂ : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B (P₂ ⊗ Q) C)
    (m₃ : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B (CochainComplex.mappingCone f ⊗ Q) C)
    (i : ℤ) :
    let F := (extendScalars.{u, u, u}
      ((algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) C).comp (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)))).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)
    let E := extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) C)
    let P₃ := CochainComplex.mappingCone f
    let cmp := fun (V : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
      (m : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B (V ⊗ Q) C) (j : ℤ) ↦
        m.localizedComparison j ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
          ((Functor.Monoidal.μIso F V Q).inv ≫ (F.obj V ◁ t)) j
    let d₀ := HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (F.map f ▷ N) i
    let d₁ := HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (F.map (CochainComplex.mappingCone.inr f) ▷ N) i
    let d₂ := CochainComplex.homologyδOfTriangle
      (tensorConeTriangle
        ((algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) C).comp (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B))) f N) i (i + 1)
    let d₃ := HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (F.map f ▷ N) (i + 1)
    ∃ (s₀ : E.obj (m₁.cohomology i) ⟶ E.obj (m₂.cohomology i))
      (s₁ : E.obj (m₂.cohomology i) ⟶ E.obj (m₃.cohomology i))
      (s₂ : E.obj (m₃.cohomology i) ⟶ E.obj (m₁.cohomology (i + 1)))
      (s₃ : E.obj (m₁.cohomology (i + 1)) ⟶ E.obj (m₂.cohomology (i + 1))),
      (ComposableArrows.mk₄ s₀ s₁ s₂ s₃).Exact ∧
      s₀ ≫ cmp P₂ m₂ i = cmp P₁ m₁ i ≫ d₀ ∧
      s₁ ≫ cmp P₃ m₃ i = cmp P₂ m₂ i ≫ d₁ ∧
      s₂ ≫ cmp P₁ m₁ (i + 1) = cmp P₃ m₃ i ≫ d₂ ∧
      s₃ ≫ cmp P₂ m₂ (i + 1) = cmp P₁ m₁ (i + 1) ≫ d₃
